identity._name_note: Approved company name. Empty = symbol-only lockup (the default, because the name is not decided). When set, the end frame becomes mark + wordmark.
identity._tagline_note: Optional approved tagline, shown under the descriptor on the end frame. Empty = hidden.
identity._contact_note: Any non-empty values are joined into one mono line on the end frame.
identity._logoSrc_note: Optional path (relative to src/) to an approved SVG/PNG logo. If set, the drawn temporary mark resolves into this file during the reveal and on the end frame.

typography._display_note: Archivo variable (OFL), used with font-stretch for the expanded headline voice.
